name: PowerToys
description_en: Microsoft PowerToys is a collection of utilities that supercharge productivity and customization on Windows
readme_excerpt: Microsoft PowerToys Microsoft PowerToys is a collection of utilities that help you customize Windows and streamline everyday tasks.
